ranked_results.content: 1.5-entmax: a Transformer with sparse entmax attention with fixed $\alpha =1.5$ for all heads. This is a novel model, since 1.5-entmax had only been proposed for RNN-based NMT models BIBREF14, but never in Transformers, where attention modules are not just one single component of the seq2seq model but rather an integral part of all of the model components.
